notes.title: Patch Note Ver1.3
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the completion of the following corrections and additions.


 Adjustment of hit detection for some objects
 Changes to some displayed text
 Adjustments to several background music and sound effects.
 Fixed problems with obtaining some items.
 Added new effects.


We have seen your play and fixed the problems.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused to our users.
Thank you also for the fixes and improvements.

We hope this update contributes to your pleasant experience!
If you find any glitches or improvements, we would appreciate your feedback in the threads!

notes.title: Patch Note Ver1.2
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the completion of the following corrections and additions.


 Adjustment of hit detection for some objects
 Adjustment of the position of some objects
 Fixes to unexpected achievement releases.
 Some UI fixes and changes
 Installation of reticles for acquiring items
 Fixes related to Graphics takeover 
 Fixes related to the removal of achievements
 Fixes to unlock achievements


We apologize for the inconvenience regarding the initialization of the unlocking of achievements and the resetting of progress after the update.
We have investigated the cause and found that a test code was mixed in.
We have corrected this issue, but it is difficult to restore the achievements and progress because they are stored in local data between users.
[We apologize for the inconvenience, but we would like to ask you to unlock or progress again. 
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause to our users.
Thank you also for the fixes and improvements.

We hope this update contributes to your pleasant experience!
If you find any glitches or improvements, we would appreciate your feedback in the threads!
